event.description:
Hey Grand Archive players! Come hang out at our casual weekly event. Test new decks, meet friendly faces, and just have fun playing. See you there!

PRD Season Weeklies
RM25 per entry
3 wins 3 PRD/DTR Alter Packs + 3 Promo Packs
2 wins 2 PRD/DTR Alter Packs + 2 Promo Packs
0-1 win 1 PRD/DTR Alter Pack + 1 Promo Pack

Lucky draw if we hit 8 players
